What this determines

Do you have a community—or only an audience?

A viable community gives the right people a durable reason to participate, contribute, connect, and return. This assessment examines evidence across six operating dimensions.

  • Whether the community has a clear purpose
  • Whether people participate and return
  • Whether activity creates measurable value
  • What is most likely to prevent viability

Recognize the problem

You may already have the ingredients. They just are not compounding.

  • Events end without a next step.
  • Content earns attention but not participation.
  • Members rarely connect with one another.
  • Community work depends on disconnected vendors and tools.
